title: Chapter 461
text:
Herlous sat across from him, organized his cards, and sneered. "Since you want to give me money, I'll fulfill your wish."

"Haha, it's not certain who will win yet." Ovenn laughed.

His laughter could be heard throughout the carriage, and the other passengers looked over.

The two of them started playing, and soon, it was hard to tell who would win. Ovenn spoke in a friendly tone. After the initial awkwardness, the atmosphere quickly became harmonious, and he chatted and laughed with everyone.

From the beginning to the end, Han Xiao kept an eye on Ovenn to prevent him from having any ulterior motives. At the same time, he secretly turned on the metal detector and wavelength detector to prevent him from having any equipment on him.

However, Ovenn did not do anything out of the ordinary. Everything on him was normal. He only played cards happily along the way, making a big fuss. He seemed to be very forthright.

Two hours later, the train arrived at the station, and everyone got off.

Alvin took in a deep breath of fresh air, turned around, and slightly bowed to the group. He elegantly smiled and said, "Although the journey was short, it was a very good and leisurely time. It will always be engraved in my mind as part of the beautiful memories. I am very grateful for your company. We are already friends, so I hope we will have a chance to meet again in the future."

Then, he waved, carried his bag, and left.

"Weirdo," Sylvia mumbled.

"What a passionate person," Fu Ding said with a smile.

"Just a rather forthright passerby," Herlous said. "We might be overthinking."

Han Xiao glanced at him and did not comment. Although he did not know Ovenn's intentions, he rarely believed in any coincidental reasons. Even though this Ovenn guy did not do anything out of the ordinary along the way, he still did not let his guard down. He patted Philip's metal head and asked, "Did you take a picture of him?"

"Took 372 pictures, hum … from all angles, hum …"

"Let's not care about him for now. Let's go find him." Han Xiao nodded, walked forward, and asked casually, "Right, I didn't notice earlier. Did you guys win any money from playing cards?"

Herlous scratched his head.

"That guy is pretty good. He won a few hundred from me. It was such a loss for me, so I got Fu Ding to help me. After winning a few rounds, we reached our destination. After calculating … Eh, it's a draw. No one won."

His footsteps suddenly paused as he stroked his chin.

"Ovenn? I've never heard of this name. Interesting …"

…

Unsure of Ovenn's intentions, Han Xiao temporarily put aside this episode and followed the clues to find the last location of the target.

This was a remote street surrounded by tall buildings, which made it seem a little narrow. In the middle of the tall buildings, there was a relatively short villa. The architectural style was in line with human aesthetics. It was flat and symmetrical, and it had a courtyard. It looked like a private mansion.

The door was a sealed alloy door. Only a small glass window on the door could see inside. There was no one in the yard at this time.

Han Xiao glanced around and saw a button next to the door. It should be the doorbell for visitors.

"We're here to find someone, not to kill … ahem, sneak in. It's best to knock. Anyway, the other party has a prophecy. If he wants to meet, he'll walk out himself."

After pressing the doorbell, they waited in front of the door. They were used to climbing over walls, so they felt uncomfortable walking through the front door.

After waiting for a while, Han Xiao pressed the doorbell a few more times, but no one answered.

"There might be no one inside, or they don't want to open the door. How about it? Are we going to barge in?" Herlous shrugged.

"Since no one answered, let's go in and take a look …"

Boom!

Before Han Xiao could finish, a loud bang suddenly sounded from above. He was way too familiar with this sound. This was the sound of a cannon being fired. Han Xiao could instantly analyze what type of cannon it was just by the sound. He immediately changed his tone and yelled, "Dodge!"

They were all Supers, so their reaction was extremely fast. They immediately jumped away from where they were.

Rumble!

A series of explosions occurred where they were originally standing. Black smoke billowed. This was the sign of a rocket explosion.

Looking up, from a window on one of the floors of the building opposite the villa, a few creatures were looking down. One of them was even holding a cannon.

The next moment, more than ten creatures jumped out of the window, fell dozens of meters, and landed on the ground with a loud bang. Even the steel floor was dented by the impact!

The thick smoke was blown away by the shockwave, revealing the true appearance of these creatures. They were actually a group of rock creatures with four arms, two legs, and one head. They wore simple and crude combat suits and held all kinds of firearms in their hands. Some of them even held mechanical axes, mechanical hammers, and other melee weapons. They gave off the vibe of a group of mercenaries, ready to take action.

They were only here to find someone and did not expect to be attacked. They were shocked.

"Why are you attacking us?" Sylvia asked with surprise.

"Someone paid to teach you a lesson," a rock man said in a muffled voice.

Teach us a lesson?

Sylvia still wanted to say something, but her expression suddenly changed. "Sh * t, Philip!"

Han Xiao looked over and saw that beside the feet of the rock mercenaries, the exploded parts were scattered all over the ground.

Philip's speed was too slow and he couldn't avoid the initial bombardment. He was blasted into pieces and turned into a pile of scrap metal.

At this time, the rock warriors made their move. They let out a strange roar and charged forward.

Han Xiao clicked his tongue. He took off a compressed orb from his necklace and flicked it beside his feet. It quickly expanded and turned into a black Amphiptere mechanical suit. However, the mechanical suit was not worn on his body. Instead, it stood to the side, an empty shell without a pilot.

This time, Han Xiao said in a deep voice, "Take care of them!"

Hum!

The eyes of the Amphiptere mechanical suit suddenly lit up!

The mechanical suit suddenly moved on its own. A swift and violent whip like a black whip landed on the chest of the rock warrior at the front.

Pa!

The powerful kick sent the rock warrior flying. He slammed into the wall and shattered a large piece of rock. No one knew if it came from the wall or the rock warrior's body.

"Order effective hum … Battle mode activated hum … The enemy has been sent flying hum …"

The empty Amphiptere mechanical suit automatically went into battle mode. At the same time, Philip's voice came from the helmet.

Philip was an artificial intelligence. He existed in the computing system. The machine was just a clone that he controlled. If the machine was destroyed, he would not be damaged. His core chip was protected by layers of protection. The computing speed of an artificial intelligence could control dozens of times more mechanical beasts than before. Furthermore, through the battle simulation in the database, he could adapt to the situation and fight independently. His combat level was extremely high!

This meant that Philip could replace him to pilot the mechanical suit, and he could even pilot more than one!

In the past, the smart chip's computing speed was limited. Its independent combat ability was weak, and it could not react flexibly. However, this was the most important quality in the ever-changing battlefield. Therefore, it could only be used as a support system to complement his neural connection. However, with the new artificial intelligence system built with [Advanced Virtual Intelligence Technology], the technological level had increased by a large margin. It was like going from gunpowder weapons to electromagnetic weapons. This was a complete upgrade of technology!

Han Xiao's Hound Style was limited against enemies of the same level. However, with the powerful mechanical suit controlled by artificial intelligence, the effect was completely different. His mechanical suit was a high-quality mechanical weapon, which made up for his lack of powerful mechanical warriors! Even against enemies of the same level, it could last for a long time!

Advanced Knowledge was useful, and an artificial intelligence with powerful computing speed was one of the prerequisites to completing the Army Style!

Han Xiao turned around and glared at Sylvia. He frowned and said, "Go back and copy the theory book for smart chips five times as punishment."

Sylvia's face immediately turned bitter. Her head drooped, and she was shrouded in depression.

Buzz!

Mechanical Force shot out from Han Xiao's fingertips and attached to the Amphiptere mechanical suit, providing his own mechanical bonuses.

Without needing him to do anything, Philip controlled the mechanical suit to deal with the enemies. He analyzed the movements of all the enemies and accurately avoided all the attacks. His heavy punches cracked the rock skin of the rock warriors.

Dong! Dong!

Rocks flew everywhere!

"Don't hit too hard. Noriose can't kill people casually."
